en: A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting the entrance to a large Gothic-style church with pointed arches and round towers. Three people in early 20th-century clothing are standing on a cobblestone street in front of the church. The architecture features tall spires and intricate stonework. The text at the top is in French and mentions the location as Bruges and the church as 'Eglise Notre Dame'.
